title: Rebound follows longest losing run in 25 years

timeline.title: Nifty's 7th straight weekly loss
timeline.line: Friday's bounce couldn't stop the longest weekly losing run since the 2020 Covid crash
more: The Nifty is down 5.8% (1,430 points) over the seven-week streak
Oil above $100, US yields near 2007 highs and FII selling drove the slide
Friday's gain came on hopes of a US–Iran truce

timeline.title: Rebound follows longest losing run in 25 years
timeline.line: Eight straight weekly falls cut the Nifty 8.7% and the Sensex 8.4% before today's bounce
more: Upbeat Asian markets, Friday's Wall Street gains and easing oil drove the open
Whether the bounce sticks hinges on the RBI decision on Oct 7
